questions.prompt: A CDN has a 95% hit ratio. How many requests reach the origin?
Which directive keeps a CDN from storing a response, while still letting the user's browser store it?
Which directive sets freshness only in shared caches, overriding max-age there?

options: It may be stored but must be revalidated before every use

questions.prompt: A CDN should cache a response that sets a cookie by default.
Which directive lets a CDN keep serving the last good copy while the origin is failing?
A request carries an Authorization header. When may a shared cache store its response?
options: Only if the origin explicitly marks it public or gives s-maxage
